clap.name: clap
clap.summary: Applause, palms meeting in front of the chest.

cheer.name: cheer
cheer.summary: Both fists up overhead, pumping, bouncing at the knees.

shrug.name: shrug
shrug.summary: Shoulders up, open palms out to the sides, the head tipped.

thumbs_up.name: thumbs_up
thumbs_up.summary: A thumbs up in front of the chest, with a nod.

sit_ground.name: sit_ground
sit_ground.summary: Sitting on the floor hugging the knees, then getting up.
